meaning: The galaxies of Cosmicflows-4 out to 200 Mpc, even across the field: Each dot is one galaxy at its measured distance, in the colour of its morphological type.

densityCap.basis: Presentation choice: 0.18 per 1,000 Mpc³, half the 0.37 CF4 still holds between 150 and 200 Mpc, so the field is even out to its edge; the taper softens the edge where the catalogue ends. The kernel holds about five galaxies at the cap. Real concentrations above the cap are thinned to it; sparser regions, as the zone the Milky Way's disc hides, stay as they are.
